Subject: Post-discovery: schedule 30-min product intro (three-slot matrix)

Hi Matt / Lisa —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed next step to keep momentum:

Key takeaways (high level)
- Pain: frequent inference latency spikes during batch reprocessing windows and subset of requests that require sub-200ms 95th percentile.
- Economics: current spend on embeddings/generation is rising; you need a predictable per-token cost envelope and burst controls.
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 in-scope, VPC peering preferred, audit logs required for evaluation.
- Success criteria for a trial: consistent p95 < 300ms for typical queries, integration with internal KMS, and <10% increase in monthly spend.

Proposed immediate next step
- 30-minute product intro + technical Q&A (we keep it lightweight; product demo + infra integration conversation).
- Attendees we recommend: Product Lead, Infrastructure Lead (platform/ops), Procurement (pricing).

Three slots we can offer (pick 1 as primary, 2 as backups):
1) Wed, Jun 14 — 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET (preferred)
2) Thu, Jun 15 — 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET
3) Wed, Jun 21 — 9:00 AM PT / 12:00 PM ET

Agenda (30m)
- 5m: quick objectives & success criteria (you)
- 15m: product walkthrough (what we can do for latency, batching and cost controls)
- 8m: integration & next-step checklist (Karthik will cover integration patterns)
- 2m: confirm owners & calendar follow-up

I attached a short discovery summary (discovery-notes.pdf) and dropped the folder link below. Karthik (cc) will join the demo to cover integration/benchmark details. Marissa is on copy for scheduling and contract/next-step items.

If those slots don't work, tell us which timezone windows are best and we'll propose alternatives.

Thanks —
Sofia
